name: After Show Hours Radio
author: ravenridgelights-turtle; based on Jason Cross (jcross)
description: A radio for FPP 10.4: direct station switching, Next/Previous, Seek and named pages of 12 presets. On request, finds names and stream links at streamurl.link and halloweenradio.net. Plays only the stream you choose.

privacy.summary: Plays your selected radio station. Searches StreamURL and Halloweenradio only when you ask; caches results locally. No analytics.

sends.to: the radio stream addresses you save or select
sends.what: normal audio requests and small Seek checks
sends.why: play the selected station and skip unreachable stations

sends.what: requests for the selected directory or station page
sends.why: find station names and stream URLs when you use Find stations

sends.what: a request for the public stations page
sends.why: find Halloween station names and stream URLs on request

systemChanges.what: Adds after-show-hours-radio.service and a private Unix MPD socket; does not modify the packaged MPD service or config.
Adds after-show-hours-radio-pulse.service on FPP PipeWire, plus its isolated config under /etc/after-show-hours-radio/.
Adds after-show-hours-radio-monitor.timer and service, checking playback and the sleep timer about once a minute.

privacy.other: Stations and named preset pages are saved locally under plugindata/After-Show-Hours-Radio. The radio API uses FPP access controls; it adds no public listener. Saved streams may use HTTP. Directory providers and radio stations see your IP and normal request information. Real uninstall removes this plugin data; export a backup first. Reinstall retains settings. No reboot or FPP audio-stack restart is requested.
